agenda: Quick overview: building your opinions page (3 min)
I do: model an opinion paragraph, drafted with SchoolAI's help (10 min)
We do: critique a sample opinion page as a class (8 min)
You do: draft your opinion & start your page in GitHub (22 min)
Check yourself: hard refresh, does your page show up? (5 min)
4th Period.connections: This week you defined AI, tried it, and named its risks. Today you turn that into your own opinion, published on your own site — images, formatting, whatever makes your point best. Monday, you'll use AI itself to go improve your Snake game.
